articles.title: Netflix's 'A Toxic Love Story' Unpacks the Bizarre True Crime Case of a US Marshal, His Wife, and a Frame Job
articles.excerpt: The documentary, releasing today, tells the story of Michelle Hadley — arrested and jailed for 88 days on charges orchestrated by a couple who framed her using fake emails and a fabricated pregnancy.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / Netflix
articles.nri_angle: The documentary is available globally on Netflix, making it accessible to Indian viewers worldwide. True crime documentaries have become a massively popular genre among Indian streaming audiences.

articles.title: Bollywood Star Jacqueline Fernandez Launches AI-Powered Digital Avatar for Fans
articles.excerpt: The actor's interactive AI personality, developed by Galleri5, shares book recommendations, personal reflections, and '2 AM thoughts' — becoming one of Bollywood's first major forays into AI-driven celebrity engagement.
articles.image_caption: Jacqueline Fernandez at a promotional event. The Bollywood actress has launched an AI-powered digital avatar that shares her book recommendations, personal stories, and reflections with fans.
articles.nri_angle: Fernandez, born in Sri Lanka and based in Mumbai, has a significant international fan following. The AI avatar represents how Bollywood stars are leveraging technology to connect with diaspora audiences.

articles.title: The Odyssey Shatters Box Office Records With $264 Million Global Opening, Biggest Ever for Nolan
articles.excerpt: Christopher Nolan's IMAX epic scores $124.5 million domestically and sets the biggest non-franchise Hollywood opening ever in India at ₹73 crore.
articles.image_caption: Matt Damon as Odysseus in The Odyssey, the first feature film shot entirely on 70mm IMAX cameras. The film has become Christopher Nolan's highest-grossing opening weekend worldwide.
articles.nri_angle: The film opened to ₹73 crore in India — the biggest non-franchise Hollywood opening ever in the country — reflecting Nolan's massive popularity with Indian audiences.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ruhaanika Dhawan Visits Divyanka Tripathi's Twin Boys in Heartfelt 'Full Circle' Reunion
articles.excerpt: The Yeh Hai Mohabbatein actress who played Ruhi Bhalla shared photos with her on-screen mother's newborn twins, prompting an emotional exchange that has fans reliving the beloved show.
articles.image_caption: Ruhaanika Dhawan poses with Divyanka Tripathi and Vivek Dahiya during her visit to meet their twin baby boys. The former Yeh Hai Mohabbatein co-stars shared the reunion photos on social media in July 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The reunion resonated with diaspora audiences who followed Yeh Hai Mohabbatein across time zones and have stayed connected to the show's cast through social media.

articles.title: Christopher Nolan Bans Ugg Boots From His Sets, Calls Them a 'Signifier of Modernity'
articles.excerpt: The Odyssey director explained his infamous no-Uggs rule on CBS Mornings, tracing it back to Emily Blunt's sheepskin rebellion during Oppenheimer.

articles.nri_angle: The Odyssey premiered in Mumbai, reflecting Nolan's continued engagement with India's growing theatrical market and his popularity among Indian audiences.

articles.title: Sharon Osbourne Urges Fans to 'Play Music Loud' as World Marks One Year Since Ozzy's Death
articles.excerpt: The Osbourne family shares emotional tributes on the first anniversary of the Black Sabbath frontman's death, while his hometown of Birmingham celebrates its inaugural 'Ozzy Day.'
articles.image_caption: Ozzy Osbourne performs live at RockFest in July 2018. The Black Sabbath frontman died on July 22, 2025, at age 76 after a public battle with Parkinson's disease.

articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan Clarifies Cryptic Post Was About Messi, Not Surgery
articles.excerpt: The veteran actor's late-night blog entry about 'the most difficult phase' after hospital discharge triggered fan panic — until he revealed it was a metaphor for Argentina's World Cup final loss to Spain.
articles.image_caption: Amitabh Bachchan, the 83-year-old Bollywood icon who has been an avid follower of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. His cryptic late-night blog post about surgery and hospitals was a metaphor for Argentina's loss in the final.
articles.nri_angle: Bachchan's global fanbase, spanning millions of Indians abroad, amplified the health scare across diaspora WhatsApp groups and social media within hours.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Earns $16.5 Million in Record-Breaking First-Day Pre-Sales
articles.excerpt: Marvel's next Avengers installment posted the third-highest 24-hour pre-sale total in the post-pandemic era — from only 1,000 theaters and without IMAX — signaling massive demand for the December blockbuster.
articles.image_caption: The official poster for Avengers: Doomsday, the fifth Avengers film directed by Joe and Anthony Russo. The film is set for theatrical release on December 18, 2026.
articles.image_credit: Marvel Studios / Walt Disney Studios via Wikipedia
articles.nri_angle: The Russo brothers are targeting box office dominance in India with Doomsday, as Indian fans debate the trailer's VFX against homegrown spectacles like Ramayana and BookMyShow shows over 159,000 users already interested months before release.

articles.title: NewJeans Returns as Four-Member Group on Fourth Debut Anniversary
articles.excerpt: The K-pop group marked the exact anniversary of their 2022 debut by releasing "2026 Summer of NewJeans" films and photos, confirming Minji's long-awaited return and signaling the start of a new chapter without Danielle.
articles.image_caption: NewJeans at the 2023 Melon Music Awards, where the group won Artist of the Year. The group has now returned as a four-member act featuring Minji, Hanni, Haerin, and Hyein.
articles.nri_angle: NewJeans' multicultural lineup — featuring Vietnamese-Australian Hanni and formerly Korean-Australian Danielle — made the group a symbol of diaspora representation in K-pop, and their comeback is being closely watched by South Asian and broader Asian diaspora communities worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sony Pictures in Talks To Revive Hollywood's Iconic Cinerama Dome and ArcLight Complex
articles.excerpt: The studio, which acquired Alamo Drafthouse Cinema in 2024, is reportedly negotiating with property owners to resuscitate the shuttered Sunset Boulevard landmark that has sat dark since the pandemic.
articles.image_caption: The Cinerama Dome on Sunset Boulevard in Hollywood, the world's only concrete geodesic dome theater. The landmark has been shuttered since March 2020 following the COVID-19 pandemic.
articles.nri_angle: The ArcLight Hollywood was a popular venue for Bollywood premieres and South Asian cultural screenings, and Alamo Drafthouse locations have increasingly programmed Indian and global cinema.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dustin Poirier Reveals Bud Light Terminated His Contract Immediately After Airport Arrest
articles.excerpt: The retired UFC star confirmed that Bud Light ended their sponsorship deal right after his public drunkenness arrest in Atlanta, saying he doesn't need 'that poison' in his life anymore.
articles.image_caption: Dustin Poirier during UFC 269 in Las Vegas. The former interim lightweight champion has been open about his struggles with alcohol since retiring from MMA in July 2025.
articles.nri_angle: Poirier's story of an athlete losing corporate sponsorship over personal struggles raises parallels with how Indian athletes and cricketers navigate brand relationships, where a single misstep can unravel lucrative deals. The broader conversation about alcohol brands profiting from consumption while distancing themselves from addiction resonates globally.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: San Diego Comic-Con 2026: Marvel, Ramayana and Everything to Watch This Week
articles.excerpt: From Marvel Studios' return to Hall H to Ranbir Kapoor presenting Ramayana: The Epic Begins, SDCC 2026 is packed with blockbuster reveals and panels running July 23-26.
articles.image_caption: San Diego Comic-Con 2026 opens this week with major Marvel and Ramayana reveals
articles.nri_angle: Ramayana: The Epic Begins becomes only the second Indian film showcased in a major SDCC hall, with Ranbir Kapoor and Yash presenting alongside director Nitesh Tiwari. Indian-American actress Poorna Jagannathan also features in the Lanterns panel.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jessica Chastain's 'Other Mommy' Trailer Terrifies Audiences Ahead of 'The Odyssey' Screenings
articles.excerpt: The debut trailer for Blumhouse's supernatural horror film, based on Josh Malerman's bestselling novel, played exclusively before Christopher Nolan's epic — and moviegoers weren't ready for the jump scares.
articles.image_caption: Jessica Chastain plays dual roles in Other Mommy — the mother Ursula and a sinister supernatural entity. The film is set for release on October 9, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Indian audiences, who drove The Odyssey to a record ₹73 crore opening weekend in India, were among the millions caught off guard by the Other Mommy trailer in theaters.

articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Drops Final Trailer With Savage Hulk Battle and New Poster
articles.excerpt: Sony and Marvel release the last look at Tom Holland's fourth Spider-Man film, confirming the movie takes place before Avengers: Doomsday and teasing a first-ever MCU Spider-Man versus Hulk clash.
articles.image_caption: A new poster for Spider-Man: Brand New Day features Tom Holland's Spider-Man alongside the Hulk, Punisher, MJ, and Scorpion. The film's final trailer was released on July 21, ten days before its US theatrical debut.

articles.title: BLACKPINK's Lisa to World Premiere Solo Documentary at Toronto Film Festival
articles.excerpt: Always Lalisa, directed by award-contending filmmaker Sue Kim, will debut as a gala presentation at TIFF 2026 in September, chronicling the K-pop superstar's pivotal year of solo ventures.
articles.image_caption: BLACKPINK's Lisa at an event in 2024. Her first solo documentary, Always Lalisa, will world premiere at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival in September.

articles.title: Courtney Stodden Calls Out Seinfeld Star Jason Alexander Over Sexualized 2012 Sketch When She Was a Minor
articles.excerpt: Stodden, who was 17 at the time, described being groped with a cellphone and told to return 'when you're 18' during a Funny or Die skit with Alexander.
articles.image_caption: Jason Alexander at a public event in 2009. Stodden has accused the Seinfeld star of inappropriate behavior during a 2012 Funny or Die sketch when she was 17.

articles.title: Disney Cuts Hundreds of Jobs With Pixar Bearing the Brunt
articles.excerpt: Pixar Animation Studios faces the deepest cuts in Disney's third round of layoffs under CEO Josh D'Amaro, even as the studio rides a $1.2 billion box office year.
articles.image_caption: Pixar Animation Studios headquarters in Emeryville, California. The studio is facing its largest round of layoffs since 2024 as parent company Disney restructures under CEO Josh D'Amaro.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin animation and VFX professionals in Hollywood face heightened job insecurity as successive studio layoffs tighten available positions for workers on employer-sponsored visas.

articles.title: Adivasi Filmmaker Ravi Raj Murmu Wins National Award for Self-Made Santhali Short Film
articles.excerpt: The 33-year-old FTII graduate from Jharkhand directed, shot, edited, and produced his 12-minute debut 'Angen' after failing to find backers for a Santhali-language project.
articles.image_caption: An Adivasi woman paints traditional geometric designs on a wall in Saraikela, Jharkhand. Filmmaker Ravi Raj Murmu, also from Jharkhand, won the Golden Lotus at the 72nd National Film Awards for his Santhali-language debut short film.
articles.nri_angle: The award spotlights Adivasi cinema for diaspora audiences who may know Bollywood but rarely encounter India's indigenous-language filmmaking traditions.

articles.title: Raghav Juyal's 'Bhai Tera Star Hai' Takes Aim at Bollywood With Meta Humor and a Nod to Salman Khan
articles.excerpt: The dancer-turned-actor's upcoming comedy casts him as a delusional aspiring actor whose quest for stardom includes a tongue-in-cheek audition for a Salman Khan film. It releases July 30.
articles.image_caption: Raghav Juyal at an event in Mumbai. The actor stars as Ajay Singh, a struggling actor navigating Bollywood chaos, in the upcoming comedy Bhai Tera Star Hai.
articles.nri_angle: The film offers a self-aware take on Bollywood stardom that resonates with diaspora audiences familiar with Hindi cinema tropes.

articles.title: Kajal Aggarwal Says South Cinema's Discipline Is What Bollywood Still Lacks
articles.excerpt: The actress, who has worked across Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi films for nearly two decades, backs Deepika Padukone on work hours and draws firm personal boundaries on intimate scenes.
articles.image_caption: Kajal Aggarwal at a film event in India. The actress has appeared in over 60 films across Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Hindi cinema over nearly two decades.
articles.nri_angle: Kajal Aggarwal is a Mumbai-born actress who bridges South Indian and Hindi cinema, reflecting the cross-cultural film consumption patterns of the Indian diaspora. Her remarks on industry culture resonate with NRI audiences following the global rise of South Indian cinema.

articles.title: Disney's Moana Remake Earns $177 Million Worldwide but Braces for Major Loss
articles.excerpt: The live-action Moana has crossed $177 million globally after two weekends, but with a $250 million production budget and steep drops, Deadline estimates Disney could lose $100–125 million on the film.

articles.nri_angle: The original Moana became a cultural touchstone across South Asian and Pacific Islander communities; the remake's struggles raise questions about Disney's live-action strategy for future beloved animated properties.

articles.title: Judge Blocks Sony's Bid to Add 30,000 Songs to Udio AI Lawsuit
articles.excerpt: A federal judge denied Sony Music's request to massively expand its copyright case against AI music generator Udio, keeping the suit limited to 333 works as the label stands alone among majors still litigating.

articles.nri_angle: Indian music rights holders including T-Series and Saregama face similar questions about AI training on copyrighted works; the case could set global precedents for how AI companies use copyrighted recordings from regional markets.

articles.title: Sohail Khan Takes Responsibility for Divorce From Seema Sajdeh on National Television
